previous_behavior: Random split by whole episode only; adjacent chunks protected but same scene-condition could cross splits.
new_behavior: Optional explicit scalar HDF5 attribute grouping; same tuple remains wholly train or validation. No generated H5 condition_id.
default_compatibility: None or[] keeps original seeded episode order and episode split.
missing_field_policy: ValueError for selected eligible episodes, including val_ratio0. No fallback to episode random split.
unknown_field_policy: Unknown/null/unavailable/empty or nonfinite/non-scalar condition values refused.
single_group_policy: Nonzero val_ratio raises; val_ratio0 allows normal read-only batches.
ratio_semantics: Fraction of distinct condition groups, not guaranteed fraction of episodes when group sizes differ.
normalizer_scope: Existing get_all_actions/get_normalizer continue to use train_episodes only.
tests_scope: Synthetic temporary H5 unit fixtures; not model/Isaac physical evidence. Separate data agent inspects actual H5.
split_scope: Existing train/validation split only. No third test partition, training or policy performance evaluation was run.
condition_order: Canonical sorting of actual group-value tuples before seeded shuffle makes assignment stable under episode renaming/reindexing when conditions are unchanged.
